seo.title: Moving Guide
seo.description: A step-by-step moving guide covering the timeline from quote to delivery, what to prepare before the crew arrives, packing order and building access notes.

hero.heading: A practical plan for a calmer move day.
hero.lead: Use this guide to understand the basic timeline, packing priorities, and what our crew handles when they arrive.

panel.text: Quote, schedule, pack and load, deliver and place.

processHead.heading: From quote to keys-down.
processHead.text: We keep the process simple so you know what is happening before, during, and after moving day.

checklistHead.heading: What to prepare before the crew arrives.

checklist.heading: 1 week before
items: Separate items you will carry yourself

checklist.heading: 1 day before
items: Defrost or disconnect appliances if needed

checklist.heading: Move day
items: Point out fragile or specialty items

tips.heading: Packing Guide
tips.text: Start with low-use items, keep boxes room-specific, and avoid overpacking heavy boxes.
items: Use small boxes for books and dense items
Mark fragile boxes on multiple sides
Keep medications and documents with you

tips.heading: Building Access Notes
tips.text: A few access details can prevent delays and extra stress on move day.
items: Confirm loading dock or street parking rules
Share gate codes or concierge instructions

cta.heading: Need help choosing the right plan?
cta.text: Send us the basics and we will help map out the best next step.
